title: orphium frutescens
intro: Orphium frutescens, commonly known as Wild Rue or Heron's Bill, is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress, and aiding in the treatment of insomnia and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Orphium frutescens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exert sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of Orphium frutescens are thought to be due to its ability to regulate the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties.
